title: Tentacle Reach Highlight and Better Commands

sections.name: Additions
items: Added Tentacle Reach Highlight
Added Right Peak Block Highlight
Added Custom Shop Menu
Added player name suggestions to /pv and /kuudra from your friend list, your last 2 lobbies and anyone whose profile you viewed in the last 5 minutes
Added Case-Insensitive Commands

sections.name: Other Changes
items: All PhantomAddons commands now work if capitalised
Party chat commands and party announcements (No Shop, pearl coordinates, FRESH, Ichor Pool) now only work from party chat, so guild, public and private chat can no longer fake them
Features that react to server messages (phase changes, supplies, chests, requeue, solo detector and others) now ignore player chat that imitates those messages

title: Minecraft 26.3 support, Stun Reminder and Tentacle Grab Warning

sections.name: Additions
items: Added 26.3 Support
Added Stun Reminder
Added Tentacle Grab Warning
Added Kuudra Rotation based direction display (this saves like 1-2 ticks sometimes)
Added toggle for donator names and a refresh button
Added formatting codes support for Visual Words
Added Preserve Last Open Page for profile viewer
Added Sacks to Profile Viewer
Added Greenhouse information to Profile Viewer
Added Coop Member Information when hovering over playernames in the profile viewer
Added Secrets Per Run to Profile Viewer
Added warnings when ping is set to 0 in about tab
Added Museum Upgrades Tab to Profile viewer

sections.name: Other Changes
items: Reworked the Main GUI slightly
Hides empty tabs on the standard version
Changed Dungeon PB times to round down instead of up and show decimals on hover
Removed a few unnecessary descriptions
Shitter List is now toggleable
Changed museum tab colours

title: Profile viewer upgrades, a better eaten timer and optional data sharing

sections.name: New
items: Share Pearl Cancel Data (About tab) is an optional, off-by-default way to send anonymous tentacle and pearl cancel measurements, to help build a pearl cancel helper. Nothing is sent unless you turn it on.
Profile viewer: click a player's name in chat to open their profile (Profile Viewer tab). It replaces the click from Skyblocker and SkyBlockPV and says "Click to open profile viewer" when you hover.
Profile viewer: the Misc tab now shows the selected faction and Dojo information.
Profile viewer: overflow Catacombs and class levels, overflow Catacombs XP in the skill totals, and a tab icons mode (the default).
Profile viewer: Fatal Tempo Terminator now shows on the Berserk gear page.
Profile viewer: the Party Finder Shift Preview has its own toggle and is off by default.
Profile viewer: Tooltip scrolling added
Pearl Refill has a toggle for dungeons.

sections.name: Changed
items: The eaten timer now shows "No Agro!" when agro is slow based on the blindness effect.
The Kuudra profit tracker no longer takes focus in GUIs other than your inventory, Croesus and Vesuvius.

sections.name: Fixed
items: Foraging level now shows up to 57 in profile viewer
